aiSummary: In October 2026, iPhone 0 led browser versions (combined) (mobile) in Australia at 48.72% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Chrome (all) ranked second at 43.29%, followed by Samsung Internet 30.0 at 5.27%.

faqs.question: Which item leads browser versions (combined) (mobile) in Australia?

faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for browser versions (combined) (mobile) in Australia?
